review_description: Quoting process was efficient and while it was the last of our 3 quotes to come in that was fine because we were being kept informed that research was being undertaken on what combination of panels/battery/inverter would work and the end result was the most detailed quote along with follow-up call to ensure we understood why the items recommended were the most appropriate for our needs.Once terms were agreed the installation was very prompt and inside the time window offered during the quote process. The team doing the install were on time, polite, provided info on what they were doing and why. They left the site clean and tidy.A couple of follow-ups were required after the install to get monitoring software operational but now working fine and largely due to personnel absences as holiday period was immediately following the install.
Knowledgable, friendly and professional salesperson. Prompt and tidy installation. Good follow up customer service.
Gave two system quotes and then visited my house to make sure installation would be as quoted
Was not pushy and was happy to discuss all options suitable to our situationInstall was prompt and tidy
Got the job done extremely professionally quickly also had a bit of a difficult job because of the age of the house that they did that was excellent them recommend them to anybody

From my first conversation with Nigel I was able to gain a much clearer understanding about solar and how I would benefit from my power usage. This allowed me to make a more educated decision on my solar system tailored to my needs. Nothing was rushed and the time was taken to breakdown every process from installation to operation of the system. The team arrived promptly and got onto the job straight away. They were great on communication throughout and installation was fast with no mess left behind.Nigel and his team assisted in getting SAPN to connect me to the grid so I had no period of time without power.I was more than happy with the entire experience and ended up a very pleased customer.

Generating our own power has been a big dream of ours, and finally we have made the dream reality. We thank Finn for referring us to Nigel of Aussie Farmers, for a friendly, helpful and knowledgeable service. After Nigel assessed our requirements, we received our quote details quickly. We researched the components for quality and found value for money in all of our system, and booked in installation.The whole process was surprisingly easy, Nigel took care of almost all aspects, transferring our status with the power agency and our retailer.Installation took a day and a half. The guys were efficient,  polite and tidy, the components look neat on roof and in garage. Nathaniel explsined the basics and thoroughly answered our questions.So far  our system exceeds our expections. It works seamlessly into our dsily routines. We are now looking forwards to negotiating a new retailer and receiving our next power bill!

From start to finish this solar company did everything, and explained how it all works in understanding and navigation of the way to solar. we felt that the honesty of what we wanted and needed was given great personal service . The only company that came and looked at our site to make sure . We were very impressed with the customer service which is quite hard to find these days the installation guys were efficient and clean and just overall absolutely brilliant .This is one very good company who are great at what they do. Thankyou much Aussie wholesalers you have done the Australian solar business proud.

Quote was not the cheapest, cheaper quotes were from a company that sub contracts.Installation was done in a week of quote, very tidy, polite and friendly and local to our area.Customer service 10/10, gave us all information, and went smoothly, we called the power company as advised, no hassle there either.

Fantastic professional service from beginning to end.Very friendly and professional. No mess left behind. The team bent over backwards to install our system in a timely manner to suit our very busy life.After sales service has been beyond anything one could ask for. A phone call is always accepted in the friendliest way and support has been given even when it has been not the responsibility of themThanks guys you have all been fantasticHIGHLY RECOMMEND AUSSIE FARMERS
We received a great service from Nigel and the team.  Excellent communication,  easy process and value for money.  Definitely recommend.
Yes!! All of the above, polite,, tidy and punctual. Fast and energetic group of very nice  young men..

Nigel from Wudinna has made the whole process from start to finish so easy, and stayed in contact with us through the install.Also special thanks to Nat and his team for the installation, great bunch of guys very friendly and professional, done a fantastic job and left our property so clean and tidy after the install.Once again thankyou to the whole team at AFG solar.Would recommend these guys to anybody.Cheers for a job well done.Andy & Vanessa.

The Team from Aussie Farmers Group helped make this process as easy as compared to when I had a former property panelled. The quality of the system and inverter used seem to be of excellent quality (system has only been up for a short time) The installation team did a fantastic job even having to work around 3 dogs at times and they left the property as they found it. So far my dealings with AFG and their customer service are second to none. Excellent explanation of how the inverter works and the app so I can easily follow what is being produced on all of my electronic devices.

I was impressed with Aussie Farmers Group.. the only group that actually bothered to make an appointment and talk to me face to face.. I could have any questions i had answered on the spot. Assess the type of person i was dealing with... very curtious, prompt, efficient, and knowledgeable.. Instillation was earlier than expected time frame, . The tradesmen who were apart of the company, not hired help, were great, efficient and explained what they were doing,.. overall so far excellent....
All good, some delays due to weather, but all done now. Friendly installers, all done in a day, happy so far.
Everything was done in a timely manner and we didn't have to stress about a thing. The 3 men that completed the install were very polite and courteous.

The quality of the system is yet to be tested fully, but if the excellent installation and exceptional customer service is any indication, I expect no issues. I am extremely impressed with the AFG Solar team and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to others.
Great experience so far. Job not finished yet. No meter installed.
Very happy with  our experience with AFG Solar, would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone on the Eyre Peninsula looking @ solarPhil & Sandra
Highly recommend AFG Solar to anyone on the EP. Fantastic service and back up. System working perfectly in Port Neill, SA. Very happy customer!

Very pleased with everything relating to the installer and installation

Right from the get go, Aussie Farmers were just amazing. Answered promptly and all my queries. So helpful. All installed before time. I highly recommend them without a doubt.

The farmers group was fantastic to deal with. We have bought 2 systems from them, 1 in early 2020 and a second in late 2021. First install was fast and efficient, they took care of all the technical stuff, like organising the grid connection after install and helping us update our meter in our outdated electrical box, which was great for us. Although we waited a while for our second install (much couldn’t be helped, unpredictable weather and delays with materials, covid related), Nigel kept us in the loop, ringing us each week with updates on the install, so polite and helpful. Also set up all of our monitoring apps for us so we can monitor the systems, which is great to see.They where accomodation with the installation and  even after we had changed our minds on where we wanted our panels. They left our property tidy and you wouldn’t have knowns they had been there. Overall great people to work with.
Early days yet but happy so far - very pleasant team to work with.
Sales was clear and informative and ran through process of best options

Quoting process was really good, there was a slight delay in getting all 3 but only by 1 week due to unforeseen circumstances which couldn't be avoided. All companies were very forthcoming with communication of what was happening.Installation was professional tidy and quick.That was a little disappointing i thought that the moment they left it was pumping power back into the grid but i got a text just this week from AGL saying they need to reconfigure our meter so i don't even know if we have been getting the value from our solar panels for the past couple of weeks. This may have been a misunderstanding on my part though I'm not sure.

*  Good information & advice from Michael & Scott re their suggested solar / battery system*  Great installation team led by Tom Parker.  Tom has excellent knowledge of the practical & technical aspects of solarpanel & battery installation & connection.*  Installation team were very competent & thorough in all aspects of the installation .... organised & tidy*  AFG will initiate the changeover of the existing smart meter & grid connection*  I have no hesitation in recommending Aussie Farmers Group to anyone looking to install a solar & battery system.

Thank you, Aussie Farmers Group Solar, on the solar system installed, this really helps to offset my power cost, the solar + battery costs, using a 10KW solar and 15KW storage battery, during the summer a negative balance in my account to cover my winter cost, for the first 81 days my grid use was about 75kwh, (mmm someone left the oven on overnight) credit of $520  output of 5KW to the grid per hour, this is going to have a long term benefit will past the time i finish paying for the solar system,  Aussie farmers group recommended I join Discover Energy, which I joined their VPP Smart network with awesome solar feed in tariff rates,on the install they were very professional the workers will manned.thank you for a great job overall.Why a 15KW battery, my daily total power average is 32KW per day over the last 4 years, after 81 days my battery usage has been about 85%, total self-sufficiency of 96% since install, and a grid input of 3000plus KW
